title: HSK 3 Practice 3
description: Final HSK-3-style round for B1: word bank (极了, 挺, 经过, 就是), true/false with 不是不 and duration + 没, reading with 'how often', and sentence building.

points.title: 选词填空 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Word bank: 极了, 挺, 经过, 就是, 嘛, 一…一.
points.body:
- adj + 极了; 挺 + adj + 的.
- 经过 + effort / time.
- 就是 + 不 = stubbornly.

points.title: 判断对错 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Traps: 不是不 (it's not that … not), duration + 没 (hasn't for …), A是A就是 (but).
points.body: - Read the whole sentence before deciding.
examples: I haven't been home for two years.

points.title: 阅读理解 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Frequency questions: convert '两次 a week' into 'every three or four days'.
examples: {我|wǒ}{妈妈|māma}{每|měi}{个|ge}{星期|xīngqī}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打|dǎ}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{电话|diànhuà}。
My mum calls me twice a week.

points.title: 完成句子 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Build the sentence, then pick the ★ piece.
points.body:
- Duration + 没 + verb + 了.
- 通过 + method + 来 + goal.
- 帮 + person + 一个忙.
examples: We haven't seen each other for two years.

questions.prompt: {这个|zhège}{地方|dìfang}{漂亮|piàoliang}（　）！{我们|wǒmen}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{照|zhào}{张|zhāng}{相|xiàng}{吧|ba}。
questions.translation: This place is absolutely beautiful! Let's take a photo here.

notes: 就是好的 isn't the pattern.
极了 goes after the adjective.
questions.translation: He's a pretty nice guy — everyone likes him.

questions.prompt: （　）{一|yì}{年|nián}{的|de}{学习|xuéxí}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{进步|jìnbù}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
questions.translation: After a year of study, my Chinese has improved a lot.

notes: 极了 goes after an adjective.
questions.translation: No matter what his mum says, he simply won't listen.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{不是|búshì}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{运动|yùndòng}，{是|shì}{工作|gōngzuò}{太|tài}{忙|máng}{了|le}，{没有|méiyǒu}{时间|shíjiān}。

★ {他|tā}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{运动|yùndòng}。
notes: 不是不喜欢 = it's not that he doesn't like it.
questions.translation: It's not that I don't like exercise — work is just too busy and I have no time. ★ He doesn't like exercise.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{已经|yǐjīng}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}{没|méi}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{了|le}，{今年|jīnnián}{春节|Chūnjié}{一定|yídìng}{要|yào}{回去|huíqù}{看看|kànkan}{父母|fùmǔ}。

★ {他|tā}{去年|qùnián}{春节|Chūnjié}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{了|le}。
notes: 两年没回家 — not last year either.
questions.translation: I haven't been home for two years — this Spring Festival I'm definitely going back to see my parents. ★ He went home last Spring Festival.

questions.prompt:
{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{衣服|yīfu}{好看|hǎokàn}{是|shì}{好看|hǎokàn}，{就是|jiùshì}{太|tài}{贵|guì}{了|le}，{所以|suǒyǐ}{我|wǒ}{只|zhǐ}{看|kàn}{不|bù}{买|mǎi}。

★ {他|tā}{没|méi}{买|mǎi}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{衣服|yīfu}。
notes: 只看不买 — he only looks.
questions.translation: The clothes in this shop look nice, sure, but they're too expensive, so I just look and don't buy. ★ He didn't buy clothes from this shop.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{妈妈|māma}{每|měi}{个|ge}{星期|xīngqī}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打|dǎ}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{电话|diànhuà}，{每|měi}{次|cì}{都|dōu}{问|wèn}{我|wǒ}{吃|chī}{得|de}{好|hǎo}{不|bu}{好|hǎo}、{睡|shuì}{得|de}{好|hǎo}{不|bu}{好|hǎo}。{我|wǒ}{觉得|juéde}{她|tā}{太|tài}{担心|dānxīn}{了|le}，{不过|búguò}{我|wǒ}{知道|zhīdào}{她|tā}{是|shì}{爱|ài}{我|wǒ}。

★ {妈妈|māma}{多|duō}{长|cháng}{时间|shíjiān}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{打|dǎ}{一|yí}{次|cì}{电话|diànhuà}？
questions.explanation: Twice a week ≈ **every three or four days**.
notes: It's twice a week, not once.
That would be seven times a week.
That would be much less often.
questions.translation: My mum calls me twice a week and always asks whether I'm eating and sleeping well. I think she worries too much, but I know it's because she loves me. ★ How often does his mum call him?

questions.prompt:
{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{最近|zuìjìn}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}{就|jiù}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}，{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}{什么|shénme}{就|jiù}{吃|chī}{什么|shénme}，{因为|yīnwèi}{他|tā}{刚|gāng}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{工作|gōngzuò}，{第一|dì-yī}{次|cì}{有|yǒu}{了|le}{自己|zìjǐ}{的|de}{钱|qián}。

★ {小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{最近|zuìjìn}{怎么|zěnme}{了|le}？
questions.explanation: 因为 … **第一次有了自己的钱**.
notes: He has just found a job.
questions.translation: Lately Xiao Wang goes wherever he likes and eats whatever he wants, because he's just found a job and has his own money for the first time. ★ What's happened to Xiao Wang recently?

questions.prompt:
{我们|wǒmen}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　。
（{见面|jiànmiàn}{了|le}・{两|liǎng}{年|nián}・{没|méi}・{已经|yǐjīng}）
questions.explanation: 我们 **已经 两年 没 见面了**。
notes: The duration comes before 没 — slot 2.
见面了 ends the sentence — slot 4.
questions.translation: We haven't seen each other for two years.

questions.explanation: 他 **通过 跑步 来 减肥**。
notes: The method follows 通过 — slot 2.
The goal ends the sentence — slot 4.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　。
（{忙|máng}・{一个|yí ge}・{他|tā}・{帮了|bāng le}）
questions.explanation: 我 **帮了 他 一个 忙**。

questions.prompt:
{你|nǐ}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　{一|yí}{次|cì}{超市|chāoshì}？
（{去|qù}・{多长|duō cháng}・{一般|yìbān}・{时间|shíjiān}）
questions.explanation: 你 **一般 多长 时间 去** 一次超市？
notes: 多长 comes before 时间 — slot 2.
去 comes before 一次 — slot 4.
questions.translation: How often do you usually go to the supermarket?
